Hi Samir —

We can accommodate Friday morning if that ends up being best for Acme, but Thu 3:30 still works for our team. Quick answers to your bullets so you have them ahead of the meeting: 

- SOC 2 artifacts: we can provide configuration snapshots, change-management tickets, SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where needed), access-control matrix, and sample evidence files (logs, config exports). Raw evidence delivery depends on controls scope — we'll surface a mapping sheet in the meeting.

- KMS / CMK: For Dedicated we offer customer-managed keys via standard AWS KMS CMK rotation; for Private (VPC/on-prem) we support HSM gateways and can support an enclave-based key-injection process. We'll bring sequence diagrams to show the envelope encryption path.

- Audit logs: Default retention is 90 days in our hosted offering; Dedicated/private can be configured for longer retention. We support export to S3 (pre-signed URLs or direct cross-account replication) and SIEM ingestion via syslog/forwarder patterns.

- SSO/session logging: We log SSO events (login, logout, token issuance) with user and session ids. Session artifacts live for 30 days by default; we can change retention on a per-account basis for Dedicated/Private.

Links / artifacts (shared):
- SOC2 evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSOC2-evidence
- Draft network diagram (attachment)

2) Acme — confirm Fri Oct 3 09:00 PT or Thu Oct 2 15:30 PT.
3) Redwood — we'll prepare the evidence mapping spreadsheet and a short demo of log export.
